recognize_zh: PAS 染色下，組織球大空泡內成群的小型圓形酵母體呈洋紅色環狀（壁染色、中心淡），大小一致，符合被 PAS 凸顯的組織漿菌。
features: Clusters of small uniform round yeast forms with magenta PAS-positive walls and paler centers, within large clear histiocyte vacuoles
A few curved, thread-like magenta fragments accompany the yeasts, likely distorted or collapsed walls
Background of foamy/vacuolated histiocytes and mixed hematopoietic cells in marrow
No true septate hyphae are evident
describe_en: PAS stain on the bone marrow biopsy shows vacuolated histiocytes containing clusters of small, uniform, round yeast forms with magenta-staining walls and pale centers; occasional curved thread-like PAS-positive fragments likely represent collapsed walls. The surrounding marrow contains vacuolated histiocytes and hematopoietic cells. Findings are consistent with intracellular Histoplasma capsulatum highlighted by PAS.

ddx.vs: Leishmania is PAS and GMS negative and shows a kinetoplast on H&E/Giemsa.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.

ddx.dx: PAS-positive histiocytes in Whipple disease or glycogen/mucin
ddx.vs: Whipple and storage material produce granular or diffuse cytoplasmic PAS staining without discrete round yeast walls.
